negative_findings_reported.finding: Limited SAR impact when multiple optical bands are intact (k=1 to k=3)
negative_findings_reported.detail: When 4-6 optical bands remain visible, optical cross-band correlation dominates prediction. Mean SAR Delta-MAE is +0.00036 at k=1, showing that SAR is secondary when direct optical reflectance is abundant.

negative_findings_reported.finding: Baseline B3 (Pixel-wise Random Forest) severe downstream distortion
negative_findings_reported.detail: While Random Forest achieved acceptable pixel MAE (0.0322), its lack of spatial context created high-frequency spatial discontinuities that caused downstream palm segmentation F1 to collapse to 0.0267.

negative_findings_reported.finding: Occasional negative SAR transfer under specific atmospheric states
negative_findings_reported.detail: In a small fraction of conditions with minimal cloud interference, withholding SAR yielded slightly lower MAE (minimum SAR Delta-MAE = -0.00136), indicating that radar speckle can introduce slight noise if optical visibility is pristine.
